m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You'll need permission from the Weapons Master to reach those stairs. She waits in the Training Hall!
Are you some new petty Warlord who seeks to prove yourself in the Shadow Queen's army?
Wait, what is this? A Burrower accompanies you?
Master, do you wish us to slay them and eat their heads?
Zarozinia, your sister, Zaltanna the MirrorMask, sent us to find you. She said as part of the Fifth Column you would help us.
:Tsssk: Nice work, Mouse. Now my cover's blown.
I must lick my wounds and reflect on my life!
You have quite the way of introducing yourself. Tell me your story - briefly! - and what you are looking for.
To reach Ghost Dog? He's at the center of Fort Rachias, of course. I'll open the gate, so you can reach the next tier.
Meet me at the top of the landing.
The entire Umbra Legion is buzzing with news about your doings, Spellbinder.
We need to find a way to get to those stairs. Let's ask these Devil's Flowers with our blades!
Battle the Devil's Flowers! They will tell us how to reach those stairs!
